gates.title: preflight
gates.proves: Stack can host the test at all
gates.threshold: health 200, image tag present, dev-agent auth on
gates.detail:
GET /health -> 200
docker image inspect quasar-steam:dev -> present
QUASAR_DEV_AGENT_AUTH=1, dev key reachable

gates.title: repoint
gates.proves: Sessions actually launch the candidate, not the pinned digest
gates.detail:
previous image_ref recorded: ghcr.io/accretion-io/quasar-steam@sha256:009ad46
pin -> quasar-steam:dev (confirmed via re-read)

gates.title: launch & decode
gates.proves: Each run: launch via control-plane, headless peer on hermes attaches, decode confirmed, steady-state luma sampled after the content-settle gate.
gates.detail:
run  session_id                            state    fps   luma   first_content_s  codec
1    9d2c1f0a-3e77-4b21-9a55-1c0b8e44f210  running  61    36.2   33.7             h264
2    3f81b6d4-77aa-4c19-88de-45b3c0119ee2  running  60    37.1   37.9             h264
3    c4a70b19-2d55-4f0e-b6a1-90cc2a771b83  running  61    37.9   36.3             h264
budget: fps>=55  luma>=25  first_content 30-55s (steam cold-home baseline)

gates.title: screen oracle: BPM sign-in
gates.proves: No pixel matcher is declared for oracle: bpm-signin, so this gate captures evidence and does not assert.
gates.detail:
Expected on screen: account + password fields, QR sign-in panel, live clock, Xbox glyph footer.
Failure mode being ruled out: a "Waiting for network" stall from the moved system-bus/NetworkManager hook.

gates.title: input · mouse
gates.proves: Injects {t:ma} absolute position then {t:mm} motion on the agent-offered input DataChannel. Baseline is taken only after the content-settle gate.
gates.detail:
stimuli : ma(960,540) x1 ; mm(dx=12,dy=7) x10
settle  : reached at t=41.2s (3 stable frames)
delta   : 11.8% of focus region (threshold 4%)

gates.title: input · gamepad
gates.proves: Injects {t:gp} with W3C button indices 13 / 15 (D-pad down / up). Profile-declared stimuli.
gates.detail:
stimuli : gp button 13 x1 ; gp button 15 x1
focus   : "Cancel" -> "Remember me" -> "Cancel"
delta   : 9.4% (run 1) / 9.1% (run 2)   threshold 4%
footer  : "A SELECT / B BACK" present -> virtual pad bound

gates.title: input · keyboard
gates.proves: Not run. Operator passed SKIP_INPUT=keyboard. This gate is neither pass nor fail — the keyboard path is unproven for this image.
gates.detail: Partial signal seen while the gate was still enabled: the cursor hid on key injection (a normal Steam reaction) but the focus ring did not move on arrow keys. Inconclusive; the deciding stimulus is click-field-then-type.

gates.title: clean shutdown
gates.proves: Times docker stop on the live session container and asserts the launcher relayed SIGTERM instead of hitting the SIGKILL backstop.
gates.threshold: stop <= 8.0s · exit == 143 · required log lines present
gates.detail:
run 1: stop_seconds=2.33  exit_code=143
run 2: stop_seconds=2.57  exit_code=143
budget: <=8.0s, exit 143 (SIGTERM), never 137 (SIGKILL)

required log lines (3/3 matched):
  quasar-steam: shutdown requested; relaying to launched processes
  quasar-steam: sending SIGTERM to steam (pid 1468, budget 8s)
  quasar-steam: terminating gamescope (pid 147)
forbidden log lines (0 matched):
  SIGKILL backstop
warnings: Steam was at the sign-in screen, not signed in — Steam never printed its own Shutdown line. Evidence is the launcher relay plus exit 143. Signed-in shutdown is not covered by this harness (no credentials).

gates.title: teardown
gates.threshold: sessions deleted via API · pin restored · 0 stray containers
gates.detail:
sessions deleted via DELETE /v1/sessions/{id}: 3/3
pin restored: ghcr.io/accretion-io/quasar-steam@sha256:009ad46
stray session containers: 0

notes.title: Keyboard is unproven, not broken
notes.body: Only open item. Re-run without SKIP_INPUT to close it.

notes.title: Signed-in shutdown untested
notes.body: Gate 5's evidence comes from a signed-out Steam; the harness cannot sign in.

notes.title: Peer-side reading, not an encode defect
notes.body: Run 2's overlay showed "device can't keep up, present p95 69.9 ms". That is the headless peer's presentation side (hermes), not the encoder. Not counted against any gate.

notes.title: Teardown used the control-plane delete API
notes.body: So no sessions were left in failed state. Tearing down with a bare docker stop pollutes the DB — the harness never does that outside gate 5, which stops the container deliberately and then deletes the session properly.
